title: Normalized finite free Kummer cohomology comparison
statement: Let $C$ be a scheme, $m\in\mathbf N$, $R=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf Z/m\mathbf Z)$, and $A$ an $R$-module. Use the root sheaf $F=\mu_m$, the sheafified tensor $F\otimes_R A_C$, and its canonical insertion maps $i_a$ from [def-pur-kummer-module-coefficients], with cohomology from [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. If $A$ is finite free, then for every $q\geq0$ there is an $R$-linear equivalence $\beta^q:H^q(C,F)\otimes_R A\simeq H^q(C,F\otimes_R A_C)$ with $\beta^q(x\otimes a)=H^q(i_a)(x)$. More generally, for a finite index set $I$, vectors $v_i\in A$, and $R$-linear coordinates $c_j:A\to R$ satisfying $c_j(v_i)=\delta_{ij}$ and $\sum_j c_j(a)v_j=a$, there is a sheaf isomorphism $\theta:\bigoplus_{j\in I}F\simeq F\otimes_R A_C$ carrying the $j$-th inclusion to $i_{v_j}$. Empty index sets are allowed.

source.place: Finite-direct-sum argument; integral-lift interpretation in the parent node. Stacks Tags 015B, 03EK and 03PL.

proof.text: Build coordinate projections on the module presheaf tensor by z tensor a |-> c_j(a) z, then descend them by sheafifyLift to the root module sheaf. The insertion-projection composite is c_j(a) times the identity. The sum of projection-insertion composites is the identity by sheafify_hom_ext and the dual basis expansion on pure tensors. Forgetting to abelian sheaves and the biproduct universal property gives the normalized sheaf isomorphism.

Choose a finite basis of A. Additivity of cohomology gives the two corresponding inverse formulas on cohomology. Every additive map between R-modules is R-linear since every element of R is an integer cast. Apply TensorProduct.lift to H(i_a)(x); the inverse is sum_j H(p_j)(y) tensor b_j. The two composites reduce to the basis expansion and the total projection-insertion identity. Thus the equivalence has the required pure-tensor normalization.

theorem kummer_finite_free_comparison (C : Scheme.{u}) (m : ℕ)
    (A : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m)))
    [Module.Free (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m)) A]
    [Module.Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m)) A] :
    ∃ beta : ∀ q : ℕ,
      (Sheaf.H (C.rootsOfUnitySheaf m) q ⊗[ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m)] A) ≃ₗ[
        ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m)] Sheaf.H ((kummerAbelianTwist C m).obj A) q,
      ∀ (q : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H (C.rootsOfUnitySheaf m) q) (a : A),
        beta q (x ⊗ₜ a) = Sheaf.H.map (kummerCoefficientInsertion C m A a) q x
